title: The Liquid Drop Model with a Yukawa Potential: Existence of Minimizers and Sharp Stability of the Ball
summary: We study a long-range perturbation of the perimeter functional by a nonlocal repulsive term defined through the Yukawa kernel, minimized under a volume constraint. Because the kernel decays exponentially, the competition between surface tension and repulsion is governed by two independent quantities, the screening rate and the volume.
